decision.finding: Whole-conversation extraction can produce excellent grounded capsules, but one grouped generation is not reliable enough: it missed one present fact and silently omitted three decisions in the longer conversation.
decision.next_test: Keep the conversation prefix cached, but ask one question per small generation and require ordinary code to create exactly one receipt per question. This separates reading quality from list-completion reliability.
